table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= item.name,  
			accname =  accounts.name,  
			packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),
			aliasname=max(item.customicode),
			manfname=(select name from manufacturer where manfcode=max(item.manfcode)),
			address = (case recipientcode when 2 then (select  customer.address1 from customer where customer.custcode=max(issueheader.acccode))
													when 3 then (select  supplier.address1 from supplier where supplier.suppcode=max(issueheader.acccode))
							end),
			CUSTCITY= (case recipientcode when 2 then (select  customer.city from customer where customer.custcode=max(issueheader.acccode))
													when 3 then (select  supplier.city from supplier where supplier.suppcode=max(issueheader.acccode))
							end),
			salesman =  users.username, 
			issueinvcode =  IssueHeader.issueinvcode, 
			headerno = max( IssueHeader.headerno),
			headerinvno = max( IssueHeader.headerinvno),  
         date =  IssueHeader.date,   
          
                 
         
          custcode=IssueHeader.RecipientCode,
 			
			 IssueHeader.remarks,	
         gcode = IssueDetail.gcode,   
         icode = IssueDetail.icode,   
         batch = max(IssueDetail.batch),   
         expiry = max(IssueDetail.expiry),   
			qty = isnull(sum(IssueDetail.qty),0),
			
			
			packunits= max(IssueDetail.packunits),
	 		saleprice= max(IssueDetail.saleprice),
			itempacking=(select itempacking.name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode),
			Godown=(select Godown.name from Godown where Godown.gcode=issuedetail.gcode),
	 		
			Id       = max( IssueDetail.IDENTITYCOL) 

    FROM  IssueHeader, 
			 IssueDetail, 
			accounts, 
			users, 
			item  
 
   WHERE (  IssueHeader.issueinvcode = :ar_issueinvcode ) AND
			(  IssueHeader.issueinvcode =  IssueDetail.issueinvcode) AND
			(  IssueHeader.AccCode =  accounts.acccode ) AND 
			(  IssueHeader.salesmancode =  users.usercode ) AND 
			(  IssueDetail.icode =  item.icode)

GROUP BY IssueHeader.issueinvcode, 
			IssueHeader.date, 
			/*IssueHeader.headerno,*/
			IssueHeader.RecipientCode, 
			
			IssueHeader.remarks,
			 
			IssueDetail.icode,
			
			IssueDetail.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable, 
			item.packcode,
			accounts.name,
			 users.username

ORDER BY max( IssueDetail.IDENTITYCOL)
